record.t: Was re-elected to 10-year terms without opposition in 2002, 2012 and 2022.
record.q: In 2002, 2012 and again in 2022, Justice Weimer was re-elected to a 10-year term without opposition.

record.t: Became the 26th chief justice of the Louisiana Supreme Court on Jan. 1, 2021.
record.q: Weimer became the 26th Chief Justice of the Louisiana Supreme Court January 1, 2021.

record.t: Received the Outstanding Judicial Award from Victims and Citizens Against Crime and the Outstanding Jurist Award from Crimefighters, Inc.
record.q: Judge Weimer was honored with the Outstanding Judicial Award from Victims and Citizens Against Crime

record.t: Taught law and ethics at Nicholls State University for 16 years before taking the bench.
record.q: Chief Justice Weimer was a full-time faculty member at Nicholls State University where he taught law and ethics classes for 16 years.
